evidence.reason: The completion deadline is enforced only after a poll returns None. If the 0.25s sleep crosses the deadline, the loop calls `_completion_port.read` again and accepts non-None evidence by returning it without a clock check, so a late completion can bypass the `_completion_window`. This is an ordinary correctness defect in the existing bounded-wait implementation.
